brief: Three cohesive original axonometric scenes: a virtual research workbench and independent check; engineered dissipative quantum computation; local measurements revealing quantum dynamics. Short captions remain live HTML outside the SVG.
limits: Conceptual illustrations, not physical equipment claims, measured data or reported performance. The dissipative cascade is an analogy; algorithms including Lindbladian ODE solvers can read out an evolved state rather than a steady state. Curves, populations and inferred coupling widths are explanatory marks.

references.basis: Agents choose tools and investigations; separate checks evaluate the proposed conclusions.
Non-diagonal density-matrix encoding embeds a linear differential equation in Lindbladian evolution.
Finite-time local observations are used to estimate Hamiltonian and dissipative coefficients.
